project.name: Honeybee Deliberation Mediator
project.one_line: A Slack agent that makes group deliberation fairer and groupthink-resistant by mediating (not debating): a deterministic honeybee-derived constitution conducts the process while a probabilistic mediator performs only the language tasks it invokes.

hackathon.name: Slack Agent Builder Challenge
hackathon.track_note: For Good requires a measurable social benefit; project is still a NEW Slack agent. One track per submission; one prize per project.

thesis.core: Most agents make Slack faster at answering; this makes Slack better at deciding. Group decisions are what Slack uniquely owns.
thesis.design_decision: Agent MEDIATES, never debates. Putting agents into the debate reproduces sycophancy / last-speaker drift / echo chambers (arXiv 2506.11825). Mediation beats direct debate (Habermas Machine, Science 2024).
thesis.framing_discipline: Fairness = process, never outcome. Elections are the motivating example, never the headline. Never let the agent hold a topic position.

deterministic_probabilistic_split.rule_of_thumb: Must be fair/auditable/reproducible -> deterministic constitution. Requires understanding natural language -> probabilistic mediator, but its outputs are always selected/bounded by the constitution.
deterministic_probabilistic_split.template: Habermas Machine: generative model (prob) + reward model (prob) + Schulze-method selection (deterministic).

layers.humans: Anonymized participants; submit private reads + confidence, discuss, receive debrief.
layers.slack_surface: Channels/threads, DMs + modals (Block Kit), consent gate, neutral handles.
layers.engine_mcp_server: Hosts both sublayers; exposed to the Slack agent as an MCP server.
layers.deterministic_constitution: See HONEYBEE_CONSTITUTION.md. Conducts the process; owns fairness guarantees.
layers.probabilistic_mediator_vicky: LLM language tasks invoked by the constitution.
layers.knowledge_and_data: Karpaty wiki (sources -> distilled rules; runtime-citable; surfaced as Slack Canvas), anonymization map, pre/post position logs.
layers.external: Real-Time Search API for vetted/sourced info injection.

architecture.control_loop: humans -> slack -> MCP -> [constitution conducts -> invokes mediator for language -> deterministic aggregation/selection -> quorum] -> slack -> debrief

mcp_tools_deterministic.name: start_session
mcp_tools_deterministic.does: create session, assign neutral handles, record consent

mcp_tools_deterministic.name: store_read
mcp_tools_deterministic.does: store a participant private position + confidence (pre-reveal)

mcp_tools_deterministic.name: rank_bridging
mcp_tools_deterministic.does: compute group-informed/bridging score over candidate statements; return winner

mediator_functions_probabilistic.name: synthesize_candidates
mediator_functions_probabilistic.does: generate N common-ground statements from reads (default N=8)

mediator_functions_probabilistic.name: predict_agreement
mediator_functions_probabilistic.does: estimate each participant's agreement per candidate (feeds rank_bridging)

mediator_functions_probabilistic.name: steelman_minority
mediator_functions_probabilistic.does: generate strongest version of least-supported credible view

mediator_functions_probabilistic.name: detect_echo
mediator_functions_probabilistic.does: classify whether a thread intensifies with no new info; returns bool + reason

tech_stack.slack_app: NEW app via `slack create agent` (Bolt, Python) in Slack Developer Program sandbox; dev via `slack run` (socket mode, hot reload).
tech_stack.engine: MCP server wrapping the constitution + mediator.

llm_backends_reused.cloud_claude: OpenClaw cloud hosting — use for reliable demo-time synthesis.
llm_backends_reused.local_qwen: OpenClaw on local machine (qwen3:14b) — on-brand/low-cost variant.
llm_backends_reused.principle: Run the echo-chamber FOIL agents on a DIFFERENT base model than the mediator so diversity is real, not correlated.

tech_stack.alt_deploy: Slack 'Add to Slack' path can front the existing OpenClaw-cloud backend without relocating it.
tech_stack.data: JSONL audit; server-side anonymization map; pre/post position logs.
tech_stack.reuse_vs_new: REUSE: OpenClaw backends + LLM endpoints. NEW: Slack app, MCP constitution server, protocol logic.

metrics.information_uptake_score: Correlation of position/confidence change (pre vs post) with injected evidence.
metrics.echo_index: Attitude intensification with no new information entering (the arXiv 2506.11825 failure made measurable).

demo.format: Recorded ~3 min, controlled run (do not gamble on live unknown-N).
demo.story: Show FOIL (seeded all-AI debate echo-chambering) -> switch mediator on -> show de-polarization -> debrief metrics.
demo.tip: Strongest material in first 3 minutes; judges may stop at 3.

tasks: point mediator at existing OpenClaw backends
build_phases.exit: agent responds in sandbox; two-package split
scripted session runs end-to-end via MCP; MCP requirement satisfied
constitution-selected common-ground statement + minority steelman, selection traceable to deterministic ranker
small live session completes in sandbox
foil echo-chambers; mediated run does not; metrics quantify
clean runs at 3 sizes; no crashes

decisions_locked: Deterministic constitution conducts; probabilistic mediator executes.
Track = Agent for Good (still a new Slack agent).
Reuse OpenClaw backends; new Slack app + MCP constitution.
Bridging-based ranking is the fairness guarantee.
Karpaty wiki is a first-class component (runtime-citable + Slack Canvas), not scaffolding.

open_decisions.question: Visible mediator (posts synthesis into channel; stronger demo) vs ambient (private nudges, near-invisible; purer facilitator principle).
How prominently to surface the Karpaty wiki (submitted artifact only vs live Slack Canvas vs runtime citations on every move).
Which backend runs mediator vs foil (keep base models different for real diversity).

risks: MCP<->Slack wiring is the least-documented seam; validate in Phase 1, not week 3.
Demo fragility; mitigate with controlled, replayable, seeded session.
Local-qwen synthesis latency on camera; pre-warm or use Claude API for the recording.
Scope creep via the wiki; freeze content at 5 mechanisms for v1.
'Whose fairness' optics; keep all framing procedural; audit log is the defense.
